name: mc_export
title: Export blocks to a file
description:
Writes the blocks of a box to a compressed file, plugins/Ashlar/exports/<name>.json.gz, for offline editing, rebuilding or later comparison. Read-only in the world.

WHEN TO USE: to keep an exact copy of an area larger than mc_inspect returns (up to 4,000,000 blocks by default), to edit it offline and rebuild it with mc_build {cellsFile:name}, or to compare it later with mc_diff {against:{expectedFile:name}}.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for statistics or a quick look (use mc_inspect or mc_render); as a rollback point before changes (use mc_build snapshot:true, the journal or mc_snapshot); for sign text, inventories or entities, which are not exported.

PARAMETERS: from/to (inclusive corners), optional world, name ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}; overwrite:true replaces an existing export). format "cells" (default): {format, world, bounds, cells:[[x,y,z,"state"],...]}, with skipAir:true leaving out air cells (a rebuild then never clears anything). format "palette-rle": {bounds, order "y,z,x", palette, runs:[[paletteIndex,count],...]}, much smaller for big boxes. canonical (default true) drops properties that equal their defaults, as mc_inspect does.

SIDE EFFECTS: writes one file; the 20 newest exports are kept and older ones are removed. The box is read through the normal tick-budgeted region reads (several for a large box), which can load the chunks it covers; encoding and writing run off the main thread. A box over limits.max-export-volume is rejected before reading.

world.description: World name. Omitted uses the plugin's configured default world.

skipAir.description: cells format: leave out air cells (default false).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing export of this name (default false).
